# Rupert Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** 9-10 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Thomas Carlyle  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Rupert has his deceased mother's golden-glinted brown hair and unafraid, straightforward, luminous, dark-blue eyes.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Personality

Rupert has an obsession with collecting insects and small animals such as toads, bugs, frogs, and lizards. He possesses a curious, observant nature and exhibits a good-natured, boyish playfulness.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)_

## Traits

- Obsessed with insects and small animals  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- Playful and mischievous  <sub>[v5 c5 P13](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Fearful of ghosts  <sub>[v5 c5 P29](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0029)</sub>

## Abilities

- Observing and catching insects  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058)</sub>

## Goals

- To observe and catch various small creatures  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005)</sub>

## History

Rupert moved to the Glen St. Agnes manse with his widowed father, siblings, and Aunt Martha. He spent his free time exploring nature, collecting bugs and frogs, and playing with his siblings and the Carrow children in Fern Hollow. When Mary Stubbs arrived at the manse, Rupert participated in her welcoming feasts and listened to her stories, though he was frightened by her tale of Henry Warren's ghost. Along with his siblings, he helped form the Good-Conduct Club to discipline themselves, which led to a night where he fasted as self-punishment for a prank involving an eel. After falling ill with double pneumonia, he recovered under the care of Dr. Hugh Carrow and the community. Later, he engaged in a minor prank where he brought a frog to Sunday school.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P42](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0042), [v5 c5 P29](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0029), [v5 c5 P60](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0060), [v5 c8 P21](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0021)_

- Moved from Juneford to the Glen St. Agnes manse with his family  <sub>[v5 c2 P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
